title: Chord diagram
description: Flows between groups placed around a circle: each group is an arc sized by its flows, each flow a ribbon between two arcs. Undirected, a ribbon joins a pair of groups and is as wide as the flows between them in both directions (a symmetric matrix counts each relation once), so a group that only receives flows keeps its arc; directed, every direction has its own ribbon with an arrowhead. Hover a group to highlight its ribbons, hover a ribbon to read both directions; the legend hides / shows groups and the arrow keys walk through groups then ribbons.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations, skipped when the user prefers reduced motion (default `true`)

props.name: deep
props.description:
Also follows in-place mutations of nested data (`series[0].data.push()`);
by default the chart updates when a prop is replaced (cheaper on large data)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage or series (shown by default for pie, donut, funnel and multi-series radar charts)

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it (default `true`)

props.name: ticks
props.description: Value ticks outside the arcs; a number sets the step between ticks (default `true` when large enough)

props.name: directed
props.description: One ribbon per direction, arcs sized by the outgoing plus the incoming flows (default `false`)

props.name: arrows
props.description: Arrowheads at the target end of the ribbons (default `true` when `directed`)

props.name: groups
props.description: Groups (names or `{ name, color }`), in their order around the circle; groups only named by `links` are appended

props.name: labels
props.description: Group labels along the arc (`tangential`) or the radius (`radial`); `auto` picks the one that fits (default `auto`)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D (default `auto`, see `setDefaultChartRenderer`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels (default 8 on every side)

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart (default: the chart type, e.g. "Donut chart")

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the engine writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, compact numbers); the page language by default

props.name: hidden
props.description:
Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap nodes, by
index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only emit
`toggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip (default: compact numbers, 1.2k, 3.4M)

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1 (default: one decimal, "40.0%")

props.name: padAngle
props.description: Gap between the groups, in degrees (default 2)

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Angle of the first group, degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock (default 0)

props.name: ribbonOpacity
props.description: Opacity of the ribbons, 0-1 (default 0.65)

props.name: arcWidth
props.description: Thickness of the group arcs, in pixels (default 6% of the radius)

props.name: matrix
props.description: Square flow matrix: `matrix[i][j]` flows from group `i` to group `j` (used when `links` is absent)

props.name: links
props.description: Flows as a list (by group name or index); takes precedence over `matrix`

props.name: sortGroups
props.description: Order of the groups around the circle (default `none`: data order)

props.name: sortSubgroups
props.description: Order of the ribbon ends along an arc: `auto` minimizes the crossings (default `auto`)

props.name: ribbonColor
props.description: Color of the ribbons without `color` (default `gradient`)

props.name: tickFormat
props.description: Formats the tick labels (default: compact numbers of the `locale`)

<script setup lang="ts">
// Messages sent between teams in a week, from a square matrix (row: the
// sender, column: the recipient); hovering a team highlights its ribbons.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { ChordChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEAMS = {
  en: ["Design", "Engineering", "Product", "Marketing"],
  zh: ["设计", "研发", "产品", "市场"],
  ja: ["デザイン", "エンジニアリング", "プロダクト", "マーケティング"],
  fr: ["Design", "Ingénierie", "Produit", "Marketing"],
};
const MATRIX = [
  [0, 42, 28, 14],
  [36, 0, 54, 8],
  [30, 48, 0, 22],
  [12, 6, 26, 0],
];

const { language } = useI18n();
const groups = computed(() => TEAMS[language.value] ?? TEAMS.en);
</script>

<template>
  <ChordChart :groups="groups" :matrix="MATRIX" />
</template>

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: A square matrix and the names of its rows: matrix[i][j] flows from group i to group j, here the messages the teams send each other in a week. Ticks mark the values around the arcs when the diagram is large enough.

migration.title: Migration between regions
migration.description: Each region's arc adds up the migrants leaving and arriving; a ribbon is as wide as the moves between two regions both ways, and its tooltip splits them (Value, Reverse). The diagonal (migration within a region) is drawn as a loop. groups sets the colors, format the unit, padAngle widens the gaps.

dependencies.title: Module dependency matrix
dependencies.description: Imports between the modules of a codebase. directed draws one ribbon per direction with an arrowhead at the imported module; ribbonColor="source" colors them by importer, so import cycles (two arrows between the same modules) stand out. labels="radial" writes the names along the radius.

trade.title: Trade between economies
trade.description: Bilateral goods trade given as a links list ({ source, target, value }) instead of a matrix. sortGroups="descending" puts the biggest traders first; the tooltip of a ribbon shows the exports one way (Value) and the other (Reverse), formatted as compact US dollars.

directed.title: Directed flows with arrows
directed.description: Navigation between the pages of a shop app. Arcs add up the visits leaving and entering each page; onHover reports the hovered ribbon's source, target, value and reverseValue, shown in the caption below.

dark.title: Dark console
dark.description: The chart reads its colors from the CSS variables of its container, here a dark operations console, with a neon palette, thinner arcs (arcWidth) and lighter ribbons (ribbonOpacity).

options.title: Options
options.description: Try the label modes (auto picks tangential labels when every name fits its arc, radial ones otherwise), the group order, the ribbon colors, directed ribbons and the ticks.

brand-switching.title: Brand switching
brand-switching.description: Subscribers moving between mobile operators, one matrix per year. directed draws one ribbon per direction and ribbonColor="target" colors it by the operator that won the subscribers; the net gains are computed from the same matrix.

focus.title: Focus on a group
focus.description: Co-authored papers between faculties. onClick on an arc keeps that faculty's ribbons and gives the others a neutral color through the link color, then lists its main partners; clicking a ribbon reports the pair.

co-purchase.title: Market basket
co-purchase.description: Categories bought together in the same basket. sortGroups and sortSubgroups="descending" put the biggest categories and pairings first, ticks={1000} sets the tick step with a compact tickFormat, and renderTooltip shows a pairing as a share of all baskets.

live.title: Live service calls
live.description: Calls per second between microservices, refreshed every 2 seconds with an animated transition. directed with ribbonColor="source" shows who calls whom; the caption gives the total and the busiest call.

legend.title: Controlled legend
legend.description: Passengers between airport hubs. legend={{ position: "top" }} toggles the hubs, and with hidden + onToggle the hidden list lives in the page, so the buttons can show presets and the caption adds up the routes still visible.

ChordChartProps.groups: Groups (names or { name, color }) in their order around the circle; groups only named by links are appended, unnamed matrix rows are numbered from 1
ChordChartProps.matrix: Square flow matrix: matrix[i][j] flows from group i to group j (used when links is absent)
ChordChartProps.links: Flows as a list of { source, target, value, color } (by group name or index); takes precedence over matrix
ChordChartProps.directed: One ribbon per direction, arcs sized by the outgoing plus the incoming flows (self flows ignored); otherwise one ribbon per pair, as wide as the flows of both directions (a symmetric matrix counts each relation once)
ChordChartProps.arrows: Arrowheads at the target end of the ribbons (true when directed by default)
ChordChartProps.padAngle: Gap between the groups, in degrees
ChordChartProps.startAngle: Angle of the first group, degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock
ChordChartProps.sortGroups: Order of the groups around the circle: data order, ascending or descending total
ChordChartProps.sortSubgroups: Order of the ribbon ends along an arc: auto minimizes the crossings, otherwise the order of the groups or by value
ChordChartProps.ribbonColor: Color of the ribbons without color: a gradient from the source to the target color, one of the two, or a neutral gray
ChordChartProps.ribbonOpacity: Opacity of the ribbons, 0-1 (hovered ribbons are more opaque)
ChordChartProps.arcWidth: Thickness of the group arcs, in pixels (6% of the radius, 8-18 px, by default)
ChordChartProps.ticks: Value ticks outside the arcs, labelled where there is room; a number sets the step between labelled ticks
ChordChartProps.tickFormat: Formats the tick labels (compact numbers of the locale by default, not format, whose units would crowd the ticks)
ChordChartProps.labels: Group labels along the arc (tangential), along the radius (radial), auto or none; colliding labels are shortened or skipped

ChordGroup.name: Name shown in the label, the legend and the tooltip; links refer to the group by this name (or by index)
ChordGroup.color: Color of the arc and of its ribbons' ends; taken from the palette when omitted

ChordLink.source: Source group: its name, or its index in groups
ChordLink.target: Target group: its name, or its index in groups
ChordLink.value: Size of the flow (negative values count as 0; flows between the same ends add up)
ChordLink.color: Color of the ribbon; follows ribbonColor when omitted

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) group or ribbon changed; detail: { index, name, value, percent, color, source, target, reverseValue }, null when nothing is hovered

events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a group by index
